caption: The drawing depicts an open, empty oval case positioned horizontally in the center of a plain, lightly textured, beige background. The case has a red, plush-looking outer edge and consists of two hinged halves. The left interior half of the case is plain with a light tan, wood-like surface, while the right interior half features an oval-shaped recess bordered by a decorative gold and brown trim, designed to hold an item securely. The inner lining of the right recess appears to be off-white with a subtle striped pattern. A small metal clasp is visible on the right edge of the case. The artist's signature, "T. J. Holloway," appears in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Miniature Case
